capabilities: sync highlights, notes, and annotations from your Kirio account into the vault
browse highlights grouped by source web page in a right sidebar panel
search and filter highlights across all saved pages
copy highlights into notes as colored callouts retaining the original color
open the highlighted text on the source page via deep links
extras: Not in the community plugin store; installed manually by copying main.js, manifest.json and styles.css into the plugins folder. The plugin is read-only; highlights are created and accounts are signed up through the browser extension, and the plugin pulls data from Kirio's cloud.
motivation: The author states that Kirio bridges the gap between web research and personal knowledge management by bringing colored highlights into a dedicated sidebar in Obsidian.
problem: Highlights and annotations made while reading web pages live in the Kirio extension and are not accessible or searchable inside the Obsidian vault.

relations.evidence: The official companion Obsidian plugin for the Kirio Web Highlighter.
Connects directly to your Kirio account via Supabase to pull in your highlights instantly.

summary: Companion to the Kirio Web Highlighter browser extension that syncs your web highlights into a searchable sidebar and copies them as colored callouts.
